title: Parks in Riyadh
describtion: Dataset contains all Parks in Riyadh

columns.FEATURE_AN: The name of the park or garden (Arabic)
columns.SITE_DESCR: Site description — here mostly وحدة تنسيق مواقع المزار = Site Coordination Unit
columns.PLAYGROUND: Indicates whether the park has a general playground (✓ for yes, × for no)
columns.KIDS_PLAY: Indicates if there is a kids’ play area (✓ = yes, × = no).
columns.MENS_ORATO: Indicates presence of a men’s prayer area (Oratory) (✓ = yes, × = no)
columns.WOMANS_ORA: Indicates presence of a women’s prayer area (✓ = yes, × = no)
columns.BBQ_AREAS: Indicates if BBQ areas are available (✓ = yes, × = no)
columns.MENS_TOILE: Indicates if men’s toilets are available (✓ = yes, × = no, مغلق = closed)
columns.WOMEN_TOIL: Indicates if women’s toilets are available
columns.BABY_CARRI: Indicates if there are baby changing facilities (✓ = yes, × = no)
columns.CAFE: Presence of a café in the park
columns.COMMERCIAL: Any commercial activities/shops inside the park
columns.surface: Runway surface type — e.g., ASP (asphalt), CON (concrete), BIT (bitumen), UNK (unknown)
columns.FREE_PARKI: Indicates if there’s a free parking or not
columns.PEOPLE_WIT: indicating whether the park has facilities accessible for people with disabilities, such as ramps, accessible toilets, or paths.
